messages:
Marco (eng-infra): Hey team, quick check — vendor says one of the APAC rack slabs is 'docked' but not yet racked. Do we have an ETA for when the GPUs will be live in us-east-asia? Need to plan a small dedicated pool for a demo tomorrow morning.
Ashley (vendor-ops): Vendor reported docking completed at 09:12 local, waiting on DC crew for racking + cabling. Tentative ETA from vendor: ~6-8 hours. They flagged a PSU firmware mismatch on 2 racks, which could add time.
Lucy (oncall): Thanks. If firmware needs a patch, do we have a rollback plan? We can't risk breaking other racks in the zone.
Ashley (vendor-ops): Good call — vendor confirmed we can isolate the two racks into a staging VLAN and do the firmware remediation there first. No disruption to existing clusters.
Marco (eng-infra): Cool. Samuel can we bump the quota for the apac-dedicated pool to include 4 more A100s if everything goes green? Demo needs low-latency single-tenant.
Samuel (procurement): @Marco pinged infra-quotas form. I can fast-track the quota request but need the terraform resource name + PR for the dedicated pool to attach billing code.
Marco (eng-infra): PR is open: #2894 — changes in infra/gpu-pools/apac-demo. Terraform snippet: ```resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "apac_demo" { name = "apac-demo-quick" gpu_type = "A100" count = 4 billing_tag = "demo-q2" }```
Ashley (vendor-ops): VendorBot just posted update: "PO 99384 accepted, ETA racks on-site by EOD, cabling scheduled at 14:00."
ProcurementBot: PO 99384 moved to "in-progress" by Samuel. ETA aligns with vendor message.
Lucy (oncall): Once racked, can we do a minimal smoke: run `rd-test --model=llama-mini --tokens=32 --concurrency=2` and check latency <120ms p50? Who owns smoke?
Marco (eng-infra): I can run the smoke and tag @Lucy for results. If smoke passes I'll flip the pool to `available` and ping @Samuel to finalize quota.
Ashley (vendor-ops): Noted. Vendor asked for rack serials to be confirmed before cabling: S/Ns sent to vendorops@redwood. Will update here when cabling completes.
VendorBot: Cabling completed for rack S/N XR-9002 at 14:18. Applying network config — expected 5-10m for control plane visibility.
Lucy (oncall): If control plane shows nodes in Ready, I'll kick the smoke test. FYI leaving a log snippet here for the smoke command we use:```
# smoke script
kubectl apply -f smoke-job.yaml
kubectl logs -f job/smoke-inference
```
Samuel (procurement): Quota request submitted referencing PR #2894 and billing tag demo-q2. Approver set to @FinanceOps. I’ll follow up if they need an invoice copy.
Marco (eng-infra): Thanks everyone. Plan: wait for VendorBot control-plane visibility, then Lucy runs smoke, I confirm pool available, Samuel finalizes quota. If any slippage >2h we fallback to staging A100s.
Ashley (vendor-ops): Copy. Will post immediate update on any firmware remediation or cabling delays. :thumbsup:
Lucy (oncall): Will monitor — please @mention me when nodes show Ready.
Marco (eng-infra): Marking this thread for status; will close after pool is green. :white_check_mark:
